vulnerability.name: USN-5811-3
vulnerability.description: USN-5811-1 fixed a vulnerability in Sudo. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Matthieu Barjole and Victor Cutillas discovered that Sudo incorrectly  handled user-specified editors when using the sudoedit command. A local  attacker that has permission to use the sudoedit command could possibly use  this issue to edit arbitrary files. (CVE-2023-22809)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Sudo. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
